import_provenance.original_statement: Establish and locate a sharp critical activity separating uniqueness from phase coexistence in the hard-core model on Z², where independent sets have weight proportional to λ raised to their size. Closing the gap between rigorous uniqueness and coexistence regimes would clarify the transition underlying Randall’s sampling and mixing-time results.
